description: This PHP source file defines classes for parsing, creating, and manipulating XML files, including XMLTag and XMLFile classes with methods for reading, writing, and managing XML data structures.

classes.name: XMLTag
classes.description: Represents an individual XML tag, including its name, attributes, CDATA, subtags, and parent, with methods for managing subtags, attributes, and serialization.

classes.name: XMLFile
classes.description: Manages the overall XML document structure, including parsing from strings or file handles, creating root tags, and writing XML content to file handles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for XMLFile, initializes version and encoding.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Clears circular references in the XML tree to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the root tag and current tag references.

methods.name: create_root
methods.description: Creates a new root XMLTag for the document.

methods.name: read_xml_string
methods.description: Parses XML data from a string into the internal structure.

methods.name: read_file_handle
methods.description: Reads and parses XML data from a file handle.

methods.name: write_file_handle
methods.description: Serializes the XML structure and writes it to a file handle.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Handler for opening XML tags during parsing.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Handler for closing XML tags during parsing.

methods.name: _cdata
methods.description: Handler for character data within XML tags during parsing.
